Single AMD EPYC™ 7003/7002 Series Processor (The latest AMD EPYC™ 7003 Series Processor with AMD 3D V-Cache™ Technology requires BIOS version 2.3 or newer) 2. 2TB Registered ECC DDR4 3200MHz SDRAM in 8 DIMMs 3. Expansion slots: 5 PCI-E 4.0 x16 2 PCI-E 4.0 x8 M.2 Interface : 2 PCI-E 4.0 x4 M.2 Form Factor : 2280, 22110 M.2 Key : M-key 4. 2 M.2, 2 SlimSAS x8 ( each: 8 SATA3 or 2 NVMe) 5. seller_feedback.feedback_text: Great seller, motherboard as described. Another perfect eBay transaction! A+
Order delivered on time with no issues
Great seller. Answered my questions promptly and when ordered the item arrived in very good condition and as described. I have assembled my server and did not have any issues with the board.

Thanks TM Galaxy for another Supermicro CSE-101IF chassis and it was another smooth purchase. Arrived quickly, well-packed, and in great condition with both system fans and the 2.5" HDD bracket as described. Great value. Highly recommend.

Board and packaging are in excellent condition, although the cardboard package itself wasn't sealed. It included all of the parts and cables from Supermicro's item list. The seller required a signature on delivery but for whatever reason FedEx's website and call center people refused to allow me to waive it or electronically pre-sign it. This caused a failed delivery attempt and several hours of me waiting at my rural property's gate. Very frustrating and it almost got returned as a result.
Received as described! Good packing / Fast shipping! Great seller!!!
Excellent seller. Item arrived fast, well packed, and exactly as described. 5 stars!
Item exactly as described. Fits perfect. Fast shipping. Good price. Top notch seller A+++
Works as described as a boot drive for my server. Value was right where it needed to be. Shipped quickly and arrived in secure packaging.
Got it in just a few days. Exactly as ordered. No damage. Easy transaction. A+
